title: SBI Tata Neu Infinity (Rupay) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Tata Neu Infinity card from SBI offering accelerated NeuCoins across Tata brands, unlimited airport lounge access, milestone vouchers, travel and lifestyle perks, designed for loyal Tata ecosystem users with benefits of Rupay Network.

eligibility: Applicable on achieving Rs. 75,000 spends in previous quarter

loungeRows.name: Domestic Lounges
loungeRows.eligibility: Applicable on achieving Rs. 75,000 spends in previous quarter
